scope: single-run exploratory REVIEWER comparison; not evaluator_selection_v1 and not a production adjudication

authorization.service: Anthropic first-party via Claude Code CLI
authorization.basis: The user's 2026-08-27 requests explicitly added Claude Opus 5 medium and Claude Fable 5 medium and required Claude Code CLI.
authorization.data_scope: existing frozen B4 source/target reviewer sample only

prompt.adjustment: Only the required item count was mechanically changed from 21 to 24; the source file's extra trailing blank line is not retained.

output_schema.enforcement: Claude Code --json-schema plus an independent local post-inference validator
output_schema.harness_compatibility: Claude Code 2.1.247 rejects the draft-2020-12 $schema annotation locally. The runner removes only that dialect annotation from the CLI argument; all schema constraints and the frozen schema file remain unchanged.

routes.harness: Claude Code CLI 2.1.247 print mode with stream-json
routes.setting_sources: project,local; both absent under /tmp, excluding the user-level advisorModel setting

routes.harness: Claude Code CLI 2.1.247 print mode with stream-json
routes.setting_sources: project,local; both absent under /tmp, excluding the user-level advisorModel setting
routes.identity_rule: Any model_refusal_fallback or assistant message from a model other than claude-fable-5 invalidates the Fable candidate; no fallback output is scored as Fable.

excluded_preflight_events: A local Claude CLI argument-order error consumed the smoke prompt before dispatch.

The first Opus B4 launch was rejected locally because Claude Code does not accept the draft-2020-12 $schema annotation; no model dispatch occurred and the error is preserved in HARNESS-ERROR-opus-schema-dialect.txt.
Simple no-project-data connectivity checks are not model scores and are not repeated after the user clarified that simple tasks may be routed differently.

The first complete Opus and Fable B4 envelopes inherited user-level advisorModel=fable despite safe-mode. Opus used Fable cross-model advice and Fable used Fable self-advice. Their RAW/CANDIDATE artifacts are retained and reported as separate composite routes, while corrected single-model artifacts carry the -no-advisor suffix.

decision_rule.candidate_label: DEFECT when observation is not exactly OK; CLEAN when observation is exactly OK
decision_rule.reference_label: DEFECT when verdict/decision is defect; CLEAN otherwise
decision_rule.valid_candidate: requested model handled the full task with no fallback; strict JSON; exact schema; exactly 24 revisions in frozen input order
decision_rule.qualification: one run per route; compare descriptively with recorded B4 baseline runs but do not infer variance or production fitness
